_about: Voice + Actions 1.5a speech-to-text comparison (docs/voice-actions-plan.md §3). Stand-in clips spoken by Windows' offline voices until the owner records his own. 'say' is SSML-safe text spoken by the voice; 'ref' is the hand-written reference; 'terms' are the names, numbers and domain words that must come through (alternatives separated by |); 'command' is the command word(s) the transcript must start with (Glim's no-Claude safe-to-type rule, §4.1).
